lead: Answer a few quick questions and we'll call to book a free test at a time that works for you.
form_sub: Free and no pressure. Three quick steps.

cards.h2: Most water problems show up around the house first.
cards.p: If any of these sound familiar, a test can show you the likely cause.

items.p: Cloudy film that comes back after every wash.
Scale on shower heads, faucets and the coffee maker.
Soap that's hard to rinse off, and skin that feels dry after a shower.
Scale inside the tank makes it less efficient and wears it down over time.
Chlorine from city water, or a rotten-egg smell from a well.
Iron in well water stains sinks, tubs and laundry.

checks.h2: Six readings, explained at your sink.
checks.p: You watch the test and see every number. If your water is fine, we'll tell you that too.

steps.h2: Three steps, and the first takes a minute.

items.p: Answer a few quick questions about your home and your water.
We'll call you to pick a time that works for you.
See your results on the spot. If treatment would help, you get a written quote to think over.

faq.q: Is the water test really free?
faq.a: Yes. There's no charge for the test and no obligation to buy anything.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: About 30 minutes. Someone over 18 needs to be home.

faq.q: Do you test well water?
faq.a: Yes. We check the common well water problems too, like iron and sulfur.

faq.q: What happens after the test?
faq.a: You get your results there and then. If treatment would help, we explain the options and leave a written quote. If your water is fine, we'll tell you that.

faq.q: Do I need to own the home?
faq.a: Treatment equipment is installed in the home, so we test for homeowners. If you rent, your landlord can book the test.

book.p: Takes under a minute. We'll call you to pick a time.
